lesson.title: Measure Words, Weights & Totals
lesson.subtitle: Measure words, weights, prices, and totals
lesson.description: Use everyday classifiers, weights, lengths, coin units, approximations, and totals accurately.

learning_objectives: Use action and text classifiers: 遍, 段, 句, 页, 张, 封, and 种.
Use physical and money units: 公斤, 斤, 米, 层, 辆, 双, 角, and 毛.
Express totals and ranges with 一共, 大概, 好多, 以上, and 以下.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Classifiers, measurement units, and quantity expressions in HSK 3.
overview.focus: Distinguish 遍 (complete repetition from start to finish) from 次, and use 以上 / 以下 after a number.

dialogue.title: Buying Fruit and Shoes
dialogue.context_en: Xiao Fang buys apples at a market stall and asks about the total price.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 请问，这种苹果多少钱一斤？
turns.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè zhǒng píngguǒ duōshao qián yì jīn?
turns.english: Excuse me, how much per half-kilogram is this kind of apple?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 五块五毛一斤，买两公斤以上还可以便宜一点儿。
turns.pinyin: Wǔ kuài wǔ máo yì jīn, mǎi liǎng gōngjīn yǐshàng hái kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr.
turns.english: Five yuan fifty jiao per jin; if you buy two kilograms or more, it’s a bit cheaper.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 那给我来两公斤吧。一共多少钱？
turns.pinyin: Nà gěi wǒ lái liǎng gōngjīn ba. Yígòng duōshao qián?
turns.english: Then give me two kilograms. How much is it in total?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 两公斤就是四斤，一共二十块钱！
turns.pinyin: Liǎng gōngjīn jiùshì sì jīn, yígòng èrshí kuài qián!
turns.english: Two kilograms is four jin, so twenty yuan altogether!

patterns.title: Ranges with 以上 and 以下
patterns.explanation_en: Place 以上 (or more / above) or 以下 (or less / below) directly after a number + unit.

examples.hanzi: 一米二以下的小朋友不用买票。
examples.pinyin: Yì mǐ èr yǐxià de xiǎo péngyou búyòng mǎi piào.
examples.english: Children 1.2 meters and under do not need to buy a ticket.

examples.hanzi: 每天看三十页以上的书是个好习惯。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān kàn sānshí yè yǐshàng de shū shì ge hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: Reading 30 or more pages of a book every day is a good habit.

patterns.title: Complete repetitions with 遍
patterns.explanation_en: Use 遍 (biàn) after a verb to count reading, watching, or doing something from start to finish.

examples.hanzi: 这段话我读了三遍才明白。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn huà wǒ dú le sān biàn cái míngbai.
examples.english: I read this passage three times before understanding it.

examples.pinyin: Nà jù huà tā chóngfù le liǎng biàn.
examples.english: He repeated that sentence twice.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Ask the price per jin or kilogram and ask for the total.

model_answer.hanzi: 这种香蕉多少钱一斤？我要两斤，一共多少钱？
model_answer.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiāngjiāo duōshao qián yì jīn? Wǒ yào liǎng jīn, yígòng duōshao qián?
model_answer.english: How much per jin is this kind of banana? I want two jin—how much altogether?

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Use 遍, 句, or 页 to talk about reading.

model_answer.hanzi: 今天我看了二十页书，把重点句子读了两遍。
model_answer.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ kàn le èrshí yè shū, bǎ zhòngdiǎn jùzi dú le liǎng biàn.
model_answer.english: Today I read 20 pages of a book and read the key sentences twice.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 1 公斤 = 2 斤 (500 grams per 斤). In speech, 毛 is common for 0.1 yuan (五毛), while 角 is used on price tags and formal receipts.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 一共 (yígòng) changes 一 to rising yí before fourth-tone gòng; 好多 (hǎoduō) keeps a low third tone on hǎo.

can_do: Use classifiers like 辆, 双, 张, 封, 段, 句, 页, and 遍.
Compare 公斤 and 斤, 角 and 毛.
Express totals and bounds with 一共, 大概, 以上, and 以下.
